/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,os,subprocess,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
if d.get("notification_type")=="idle_prompt": sys.exit()
subprocess.run(["osascript","-e","on run a","-e","display notification (item 2 of a) with title (item 1 of a) sound name \"Glass\"","-e","end run","Claude · "+os.path.basename(d.get("cwd") or "?"),d.get("message") or "입력을 기다려요"])' 2>/dev/null || true
